assessments.reasoning: IBM's publications server served the exact frozen PDF bytes. PDF page 1 identifies the IBM Informix 4GL Reference Manual, Version 7.32, and March 2003, and includes the CT1VBNA part number. PDF page 2 repeats the manual identity in its running title and bears IBM's copyright notice. The first two pages directly support the historical manual edition and month.

challenge.method: Compare the exact PDF cover and copyright page with the link and edition note on IBM's v7.50.xC5 publication list at https://www.ibm.com/support/pages/ibm-informix-4gl-v750xc5-publication-library-pdf-english-only.
challenge.results: The 7.50.xC5 list explicitly identifies its reference-manual entry as a previous 7.32 edition that received no 7.50 update. Following the entry leads to the exact frozen CT1VBNA PDF locator.

limitations: The finding dates and identifies this manual edition. Product release timing, language changes across versions, and runtime behavior are outside its scope.
